title: XLSX grid per-paint conditional-format stats, worksheet handles and sheet thumbnails
observed: xlsx-conditional-formats.xlsx renders its 30-row data bars, colour scale and 4TrafficLights icon set: the body canvas carries 2,012 green and 606 red channel-dominant pixels. tests/component/xlsx-render-perf.test.mjs (17/17) observes the three per-frame costs directly: 60 repaints on one revision compute the rule stats once; a 50,000-cell rule range is capped at the 4,096-cell budget and clamped to the used extent; paintGrid opens exactly one worksheet handle per frame and frees it in a finally; listing a 40-sheet workbook reads 0 cells and opens 0 handles, and painted previews reuse the per-revision cache.
gap: No CDP frame-time trace was captured, so the suite proves the data-sized work is gone but does not report a p99 frame duration.

title: XLSX frozen panes ignore the freeze offset in headers, hit-testing, repaint and the editor
observed: charts-images.xlsx reports freezeRow=2/freezeColumn=2. After scrolling to column K / row 13, A–B and rows 1–2 stay pinned and painted; the grid host and surface agree.
gap: Pointer hit-testing, column-header resize and the inline editor position were not exercised by a screenshot scenario.

title: XLSX merged regions, anchored objects, text overflow, icon sets, DPR and canvas limits
observed: The merged region is still drawn after its anchor is scrolled away; negative data bars and 4/5-bucket icon glyphs render; at DPR 2 every visible grid canvas backing store follows the 2× ratio.
gap: Hidden-row/column anchor drift and text overflow into empty neighbours need a dedicated fixture. Canvas pixel limits need an oversized-worksheet fixture.

title: DOCX multi-page shell page-height cache, thumbnails, gutter inflation, fit-width and drag outline
observed: page-sizes.docx renders five page surfaces and five thumbnails with distinct heights (198/99/181 px at a fixed 140 px width), so portrait/landscape pages are not forced into one aspect ratio. thumbnails render text and images.
gap: The stale per-index measured-height cache and thumbnail cache thrash require a scripted document switch; this snapshot only verifies the visible shell.

title: DOCX editor global keydown scope, tracked-changes toolbar, dead context menu, fake paste, dirty tracking
observed: tests/component/docx-edit-interactions.test.mjs (16/16) observes every reported behaviour on the mounted editor: shortcuts are scoped to the editor root and unsaved changes are tracked; the toolbar locks formatting while tracked changes are enabled; the context menu opens from the document surface and its cut/split/delete/table actions mutate the model; clipboard paste inserts at the caret and never reports a fake success; New asks before discarding dirty edits. The /docx-editor route mounts the toolbar and editable page with status ready and undo/redo indicators.
gap: The demo editor route exposes no file input, so the interaction suite mounts the editor directly instead of capturing a route screenshot; IME composition and two simultaneous editor instances were not exercised.

title: DOCX comment cards are not anchored to text and scale with page zoom
observed: review-threads.docx renders 11 cards, 9 inline markers and 9 comment highlights. Cards are ordered by anchor and the 100% layout matches anchor + 4 px collision stacking to 0 px error. At 50% and 200% viewer zoom the card heights stay 71/57 px (no pane scaling).
gap: Card click → anchor reveal and highlight click → card focus were not scripted. The 50/200% screenshots put the gutter outside the narrow viewport, so the height evidence comes from the DOM snapshot.

title: DOCX comment collection loses replies, header/footer comments, edited comments and repeats table anchors
observed: The review-threads fixture yields a header comment, a thread with two replies (Alex/Morgan), a table-cell comment, a cross-paragraph comment and unique card ids. table-structures.docx renders merged, nested and repeating-header tables without duplicate cards.
gap: Editing a commented paragraph and a table that spans pages were not exercised; those need scripted edits.

title: DOCX floating images page origin, behind-text z-order, rotation, wrap and stale drag hit box
observed: The #72 corpus now supplies the missing floating image. docx-svg-pictures.docx holds a 200x120 column-relative (720000 EMU = 75.6 px) picture with wrapSquare and 12 px wrap distance. In /docx-viewer it renders as a wrapped float (data-docx-image-layout=wrapped, float:left, margin-left 88 px); its page offset is 184 px = 96 px left margin + 88 px, so the wrapped path is placed from the column origin. In /docx-editor the converted behind-text image is still misplaced: after Import + Behind Text the container keeps horizontalRelativeTo=column, xPx=75.6, but is painted at left:76 px inside the 96 px margin (screen x 388 px; expected 484 px = page 312 px + margin 96 px + offset 76 px). View mode paints a wrapNone variant of the same column anchor at left:171.6 px, so view and edit modes disagree by exactly one margin. The behind layer itself is now correct (data-docx-image-behind=true, image layer z-index -1, container -99999 and pointer-events:none). Rotation, wrapText/tight/through, exclusion flow and the drag hit box pass in tests/component/docx-floating-image-layout.test.mjs (8/8) and tests/unit/docx-floating-image.test.mjs (10/10).
gap: No committed fixture carries a page-anchored wrapNone image or a 90-/270-degree rotated image; those configurations are observed at the renderer/component level rather than through a route capture. The confirmed edit-mode origin defect is described in the evidence above and is not covered by an automated gate yet.

title: DOCX thumbnail signature, resolution cache, stale unavailable paint and O(N²) invalidation
observed: The thumbnail panel renders real page content, keeps images and headers, and gives mixed-size pages distinct aspect ratios. No blank or 'unavailable' thumbnail is visible after load.
gap: Style-table signature coverage and cache hits after a DPR/resolution change need a scripted edit/DPR fixture; this snapshot only proves the rendered output.

title: DOCX thumbnails lose scoped CSS, bake in editor chrome and have no image-decode timeout
observed: The report-with-image thumbnails show the styled heading, table borders and embedded image; no active-paragraph tint or editor handles are baked into the thumbnail.
gap: A stalled image decoder needs a fault-injection fixture to exercise the timeout path; that cannot be observed from a normal screenshot.

title: XLSX charts: data labels, signed 100% denominator, log axis, smooth/markers, combo axes, date axis
observed: The reported data-label, 100% denominator, log, smooth/marker and date-axis defects are refuted by tests/component/xlsx-chart-rendering.test.mjs (10/10): bar/line/area labels render with number format and series-name flags, +5/-5 renders as +/-50%, log decades are equally spaced, smooth lines are cubic and triangle markers keep their shape, date points are spaced by elapsed days, and a shared combo axis draws no right-hand axis. On the route, xlsx-chart-families.xlsx renders the 100% column chart with -100..100% ticks, the smooth line, pie/doughnut/scatter and area families. One combo defect remains, in the opposite direction: Combo One Axis (barChart + lineChart on axId 100) and Combo Two Axes (lineChart on axId 200 with a Secondary title) both render one left axis -10..30 and no Secondary label. tests/unit/fixture-corpus.test.mjs (10/10) confirms the workbook really carries two valAx on the two-axis combo; loadWorkbookChartAssets returns axes: [] for both, because the classic parser only merges the first catAx/valAx into chart.axes and never appends the second valAx (id 200). buildComboGroups therefore falls back to valueAxis 100 for both groups and the secondary domain is never drawn.
gap: No committed workbook sets chart data-label flags, logBase, dateAx or an explicit marker symbol, so those renderer paths are asserted with chart models rather than a route screenshot. The two-axis combo defect is recorded in the evidence JSON and is not gated yet.

title: XLSX chart axes and layout: gridlines, label position/skip, tick number formats, legend wrap, plot insets, pie angles
observed: tests/component/xlsx-chart-axis.test.mjs (12/12) observes each sub-claim: 0%/currency/date tick formats, majorGridlines on both axes, labelPosition none/high, tickLabelSkip=2, 12 long categories rotated -45 degrees and skipped, wrapped vertical and horizontal legends, a measured plot inset wider than the old 42 px constant, pie legend/geometry agreement for zero and negative slices, and BarOfPie starting at 12 o'clock. On the route, xlsx-chart-families.xlsx draws SVG tick labels (-10..30), Q1-Q4 categories, a right-hand legend and the 100% axis as -100..100%.
gap: The committed workbook has no 12-long-label or long-legend chart, so wrap/rotation/skip are asserted with chart models rather than a route screenshot.
